$comment: Advisories the audit gate excludes, one entry per GHSA per scope.
Every field is mandatory and `expires` is enforced: an expired entry stops excluding
and the gate goes red again, so an exception cannot quietly become permanent.
Add an entry only with evidence that the code path is unreachable or the risk is
genuinely accepted; a new advisory on the same package is NOT covered.

exceptions.reason: Unreachable vulnerable pattern parsing: the sole production trash caller passes glob:false; real installed trash regression and a positive control verify the glob boundary. Maintainers revalidate on dependency/caller changes and before expiry.
